slides.headline: Barchetta opens on the Intracoastal
slides.body: Thursday, Oct. 1, at 1880 SE 17th St. in Fort Lauderdale. The Italian chophouse has handmade pastas, seafood, steaks and waterfront views.

slides.headline: Airhockey and Augusto at Las Rosas
slides.body: 10 p.m. Saturday, Oct. 3, at Las Rosas, 2898 NW 7th Ave. Admission is free for Airhockey, Augusto, Ana No Duerme, Micelady and Moni Musique.

slides.headline: French Horn Collective at Lummus Park
slides.body: 6 to 7:30 p.m. Sunday, Oct. 4, at Lummus Park, 1130 Ocean Dr. Admission is free for the Ocean Drive Promenade Music Series show.

slides.headline: Clifford the Big Red Dog at The Parker
slides.body: 1 p.m. Sunday, Oct. 4, at The Parker, 201 SW Fifth Ave. Tickets cost $23.60 for the family musical based on Norman Bridwell’s character.

slides.headline: House of Horror at Tropical Park
slides.body: Open 6 to 11 p.m. Sunday through Thursday and 6 p.m. to midnight Friday and Saturday at Tropical Park, 7900 SW 40th St. The carnival is closed Oct. 5.
